use: Measure characteristic functional-group absorptions (identification, reaction monitoring).
simulation: Spectrum built by summing each species' characteristic peak positions and intensities.
notes: Reference model profile: ATR-FTIR infrared spectrometer
Spec values not individually verified (verified = false). Spectra are model spectra generated from a table of characteristic functional-group frequencies (not quantum-chemical calculations).
sources: Thermo Nicolet iS5 product literature (to be archived and checked)

acquire.description: Acquire an ATR IR spectrum (~1 min): put the sample in an ir_card (or small vial) on ftir_1. Result is a peak list [{wavenumber, absorbance, assign_hint}]

alternatives.model: Thermo Fisher Nicolet iS5 + iD7 ATR
